mutants.description: Over-temperature indicator is updated only at each blink half-period terminal count, to keep it in step with the panel blink, instead of following the live OTP condition on every clock
mutants.reason: When otp_state rises or falls, Red_LED2 changes only at the next blink terminal count, up to a half-period late, and an OTP pulse between two terminal counts is never shown.

mutants.description: Power-good LED is held dark while the latch is set or being asserted, as if a board that has given up could not be in regulation, instead of following the comparator straight through
mutants.reason: With latch_state or latch_assert high and pgood high, pgood_LED is 0 where the design says it must be 1. No other fault input changes it.

mutants.description: Blink timebase is frozen while the latch is set, on the reasoning that the solid latched indication masks the blink anyway, so it no longer runs freely
mutants.reason: While a latch input is high, the blink counter holds its value. Once the latch inputs drop with strikes still outstanding, the Red_LED1 blink is phase-shifted by the time spent latched, and the half-period that was cut off by the latch lasts longer than it should.
